name: RescaleDeviceService

parameters.help_en: The scaling operation. Set the value to Add to add new resources
parameters.help_zh: 扩容资源方式。枚举类型，取值：Add（生产新资源）
parameters.name: rescale_type

parameters.help_en: The region level of the scale-out. Set the value to RegionId. RegionId specifies that resource scale-out is performed based on the ID of the edge node
parameters.help_zh: 扩容区域级别。枚举类型，取值：RegionId（指定边缘节点ID）
parameters.name: rescale_level

parameters.help_en: The timeout period for asynchronous scale-out. Unit: seconds. Default value: 300
parameters.help_zh: 异步扩容资源的超时时间，单位秒，默认300
parameters.name: timeout

parameters.help_en: The required resources. The value must be a JSON string
parameters.help_zh: 扩容资源区域需求，Json数组格式的字符串
parameters.name: resource_selector

parameters.help_en:
The type of the network. The value must be of the enumerated data type. Valid values:

1 (default): Internet

2: internal network
parameters.help_zh:
网络类型。枚举类型，取值：

1（默认值）：公网

2：内网
parameters.name: ip_type

parameters.help_en: The information about the resource specification template. The value must be a JSON string
parameters.help_zh: 资源规格模版信息，Json格式的字符串
parameters.name: resource_info
